svg.title: A qualification funnel worth measuring
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-deal-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: A qualification funnel worth measuring; subtitle: Illustrative cohort of 100 records; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Invented nested cohort; these counts are not observed conversion rates or a forecast.; caption: Measure why records leave each gate; signed clients and completed distributions are different outcomes.; stages: label: Records screened; value: 100; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Deduplicated records with identifiable custodians or case numbers.; label: Plausible net value; value: 30; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Illustrative survivors after preliminary eligibility and liability checks.; label: Evidence feasible; value: 12; numeric value: 12.0; detail: A credible document path exists within a defined research budget.; label: Authorized clients; value: 4; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Eligible claimants choose assistance under lawful agreements.; label: Paid resolutions; value: 2; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Actual collected fees, potentially many months after intake.
